title: upready-store theme preset: canon token values per mode (upready.theme-preset/v0)
description: One preset = one visual identity of the storefront written in the canon token vocabulary (names of ~/upready/packages/geist-kit/theme.css). modes.<mode>.tokens mirrors modes.<mode>.tokens of theme-configurator's theme-output.schema.json, so a generated theme imports into this shape without a format change. Decision: docs/design-system/00-program-2026-09-06.md section 11.

id.description: value of <html data-theme>; file name is <id>.theme.json

label.description: plain-language name shown in the settings panel (rule 18e: no raw ids on screen)

dictionary.description: the canon vocabulary the token names come from; a second dictionary is a program decision, not a preset field

source.description: where the VALUES were read from, with a version or commit: '@medusajs/ui-preset@2.19.0 dist/index.js :root/.dark', 'geist-kit/theme.css@<commit>', 'theme-configurator@<semver> configHash <hash>'

generator.description: theme-configurator@<semver>; present only for generated presets (mirrors theme-output.generator)

configHash.description: mirrors theme-output.configHash; present only for generated presets

tokens.description: token name -> CSS value string, exactly as emitted into [data-theme=<id>][data-mode=<mode>]; the key set must be identical across both modes and across every preset (checked by the build script, not by this schema)
